_comment: DRAFT demo guidelines for UCUMverter. Values are illustrative only and NOT for clinical use. Review before relying on any of them.

guidelines.name: Gentamicin - extended interval (once daily)
guidelines.source: Demo values loosely based on adult extended-interval aminoglycoside dosing. Not for clinical use.
guidelines.drugEcl: ^ 929360071000036103 |Medicinal product unit of use reference set| AND < 350121009 |Product containing gentamicin in parenteral dose form|

guidelines.name: Vancomycin - loading dose
guidelines.source: Demo values loosely based on adult vancomycin loading dose guidance. Not for clinical use.
guidelines.drugEcl: ^ 929360071000036103 |Medicinal product unit of use reference set| AND < 350180007 |Product containing vancomycin in parenteral dose form|

guidelines.name: Phenytoin - loading dose
guidelines.source: Demo values loosely based on adult phenytoin sodium loading dose guidance. Dose is expressed as phenytoin sodium. Not for clinical use.
guidelines.drugEcl: ^ 929360071000036103 |Medicinal product unit of use reference set| AND ((< 763158003 |Medicinal product| : 127489000 |Has active ingredient| = 387220006 |Phenytoin|) OR (< 763158003 |Medicinal product| : 762949000 |Has precise active ingredient| = 387416005 |Phenytoin sodium|))

guidelines.name: Digoxin - loading dose
guidelines.source: Demo values loosely based on adult digoxin loading dose guidance. Not for clinical use.
guidelines.drugEcl: ^ 929360071000036103 |Medicinal product unit of use reference set| AND (< 763158003 |Medicinal product| : 127489000 |Has active ingredient| = 387461009 |Digoxin|)
